caption: The drawing depicts a single, translucent drinking glass with a light blue-green tint. The glass is cylindrical and slightly tapers towards the bottom. Its surface features a raised, textured pattern of diagonal lines that crisscross, forming a woven appearance around the exterior. The interior and top rim of the glass are smooth, with the rim depicted as an oval due to the perspective. The background is plain and off-white, and there is a signature "V.L. title: Flip Glass
